```ts
const HEX = "ab".repeat(32);
const TIME = "2026-10-04T08:15:30.123Z";

describe("FindingRequest", () => {
  const finding = { target: { kind: "post", id: POST }, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" };

  test("a moderator's finding cites a korbat rule, R2 among them, about a post, an account or a korbat link", () => {
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId }).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.parse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).target).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "some_one" });
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "link", url: "https://korbat.example/post/" + POST } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it has no other ground than a rule: a finding never alleges illegality and never goes the path that records no sender", () => {
    for (const ground of ["illegal", "csam", "order", "law", ""]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ground }).success, ground).toBe(false);
    const { ground: _ground, ...withoutGround } = finding;
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse(withoutGround).success).toBe(false);
    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ...extra }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: "R7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its category is one of the Transparency Database's, but not the one that says a notifier was not sure", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success, category).toBe(category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the categories a finding may carry are exported as a list, in the Transparency Database's order, for the console's form: exactly those the request takes", () => {
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toEqual(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE"));
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);
    expect(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success)).toEqual(FINDING_CATEGORIES);
  });

  test("the answer names the case the finding opened or joined", () => {
    expect(FindingResponse.parse({ caseId: CASE })).toEqual({ caseId: CASE });
    expect(FindingResponse.safeParse({ caseId: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});

      { at: TIME, event: "item", refId: OTHER, seq: 1, intakeKind: "user", ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: true, reexamination: false, decisionKind: null, outcome: null, staffHandle: null, result: null },
      { at: TIME, event: "decision", refId: OTHER, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", staffHandle: "mod_anna", result: null },
    ],
  };

  test("parses a case with its target, suspicion, snapshots, items, decisions, appeals, texts and history", () => {
    const parsed = CaseView.parse(view);
    expect(parsed.snapshots).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(parsed.items[0]!.source.kind).toBe("anonymous");
    expect(parsed.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!.sealed?.list).toEqual([{ postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 }]);
    // An account's case: its live fields, no suspicion, and never an image.
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [] };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(account).success).toBe(true);
    // A target whose row is gone is still an answer: staff see what is.
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, target: { type: "post", id: POST, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`, authorHandle: null, state: null, level: null } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a withheld snapshot carries its id, time and digest and no content, whatever the answer held", () => {
    const withheld = CaseSnapshot.parse({ ...shown, withheld: true });
    expect(Object.keys(withheld).sort()).toEqual(["digest", "id", "takenAt", "withheld"]);
  });

  test("a snapshot that is shown carries everything its digest covers: the console recomputes the digest from the answer", async () => {
    const parsed = CaseSnapshot.parse(shown);
    if (parsed.withheld) throw new Error("the snapshot is shown");
    const expected = await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, targetType: "post", postState: "visible" });
    expect(await snapshotDigest(parsed)).toBe(expected);
    const { salt: _salt, ...withoutSalt } = shown;
    expect(CaseSnapshot.safeParse(withoutSalt).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's list holds at most the 500 rows the case answer carries", () => {
    const row = { postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 };
    const withList = (rows: number) => ({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, sealed: { posts: rows, images: rows, deletedPosts: 0, list: Array.from({ length: rows }, () => row) } }] }] });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(500)).success).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(501)).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("suspicion holds counts and days only", () => {
    const bad = { ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: TIME, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } } };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(bad).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, newestPostOn: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the queue and the overview", () => {
  const row = { id: CASE, lane: 0, targetType: "post", openedAt: TIME, oldestOpenAt: TIME, openItems: 2, rules: ["R5"], categories: ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE"], allegesIllegal: true, suspect: false, reexamination: false, deferred: false };

  test("a page of the queue holds at most 50 cases and the cursor of the next", () => {
    expect(QUEUE_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(50);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [row], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => row), nextCursor: "abc_-123" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 51 }, () => row), nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [{ ...row, lane: 3 }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the queue's cursor is an opaque word: letters, digits, dashes and underscores", () => {
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "eyJhIjoxfQ_-" }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const cursor of ["", "a b", "a/b", "a=b", "x".repeat(401)]) expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor }).success, cursor).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the overview holds counts, times, staff handles and cases", () => {
    const overview = {
      lanes: [
        { lane: 0, open: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
        { lane: 1, open: 0, oldestAt: null },
        { lane: 2, open: 5, oldestAt: TIME },
      ],
      appealsWaiting: 3,
      appealsYouMayReview: 1,
      appealsWithoutReviewer: 2,
      reveals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE }] },
      imagesToday: [{ handle: "mod_anna", count: 4 }],
      findingsToday: [{ handle: "mod_anna", count: 1 }],
      mailsWaiting: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 1, outcomes: 0 },
      mailsFailed: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 2 },
      releaseOverdue: 0,
      erasureOverdue: { caseEvidence: 0, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 0, redactions: 0, images: 0, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 0 },
      deferUnproven: false,
      protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, kind: "dismissed" }] },
      sealsDeclined: { total: 0, items: [] },
      interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, posts: 2, images: 5 }] },
    };
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(overview).success).toBe(true);
    // Each of the three lists holds at most as many rows as the reveals' list does.
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, interimSeals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.interimSeals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, lanes: overview.lanes.slice(0, 2) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reveals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.reveals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, releaseOverdue: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("erasureOverdue is one count for each due rule of retention: all eight, each a whole number from 0", () => {
    const counts = { caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 1, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 3 };
    expect(ErasureOverdue.parse(counts)).toEqual(counts);
    expect(Object.keys(ErasureOverdue.shape).sort()).toEqual(["accessLog", "caseEvidence", "contacts", "drafts", "images", "intakeRecords", "redactions", "statements"]);
    for (const key of Object.keys(counts)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...missing } = counts as Record<string, number>;
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse(missing).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: -1 }).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: 1.5 }).success, key).toBe(false);
    }
    // The overview carries it: an answer without it is refused, so a console never reads "nothing is late" from a missing member.
    const parsed = StaffOverview.safeParse({ lanes: [], erasureOverdue: counts });
    expect(parsed.success).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape)).toContain("erasureOverdue");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/src/cli/staff-cases.ts`

```ts
/**
 * The staff command line's commands for moderation cases (3c design, section 7.13): link, unlink, limits, text-verify,
 * account-facts and access-request. staff.ts parses their arguments, reads their settings and opens their connections;
 * this file holds what each does, over the connections it is handed. Each sets the 10-second lock timeout in every
 * transaction it opens, writes its audit row in the transaction of its change and as that transaction's last statement
 * (the insert holds the chain's head until the commit), and says so when it changed nothing it was asked to.
 *
 * This file has no entry point of its own, so both bundles can include it (build.mjs says why that matters).
 */
import { and, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { MEASURE_KINDS, snapshotDigest, textDigest, type SnapshotDigestInput } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { moderationLimits, profiles, staffPersonalAccounts, users, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../auth";
import { imageModerationStates } from "../media";
import { accessDraftForAccount, accessDraftForContacts, type AccountAccessDraft, type ContactsAccessDraft } from "../moderation";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../staff";

/** What a command reads and writes through: its own connection, or a transaction a test hands in. */
type Runner = Db | DbTx;

const rowsOf = async <T>(q: Runner, query: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<T[]> => (await q.execute(query)) as unknown as T[];
const uuidArray = (ids: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;
const textArray = (values: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${values.join(",")}}`}::text[]`;

/** Runs `change` in a transaction that waits at most 10 seconds for a lock, as every staff command waits. */
function changing<T>(db: Runner, change: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    return change(tx);
  });
}

/** A handle as the operator types it, with or without its at sign, in the lower case the profiles hold. */
export const handleArg = (arg: string): string => arg.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- link and unlink

export type Changed = { ok: true; lines: string[] } | { ok: false; problem: string };

/**
 * Records, or with `remove` takes back, that a personal account is a staff member's own (the recusal check of 3c reads
 * the links; no API role can). As the migrator, in one transaction: the staff account's row and the personal account's
 * are locked FOR SHARE, so neither can be promoted, demoted or taken down under the check; a link is recorded only for
 * a live staff account and a live account that is not staff. The audit row names the staff account and nothing of the
 * link, which must not spread.
 */
export async function changeLink(migrateDb: Runner, staffEmail: string, personalHandle: string, remove: boolean): Promise<Changed> {
  const handle = handleArg(personalHandle);
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const [staff] = await tx
      .select({ id: users.id, role: users.role })
      .from(users)
      .where(and(sql`lower(${users.email}) = lower(${staffEmail})`, isNull(users.deletedAt)))
      .limit(1)
      .for("share");
    if (!staff) return { ok: false, problem: `no live account for ${staffEmail}` };
    const [profile] = await tx.select({ id: profiles.id }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    if (remove) {
      const gone = await tx.delete(staffPersonalAccounts).where(and(eq(staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId, staff.id), eq(staffPersonalAccounts.personalUserId, profile.id))).returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
      if (gone.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
      await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_removed", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
      return { ok: true, lines: [`unlink: @${handle} is no longer linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
    }
    if (staff.role === "user") return { ok: false, problem: `${staffEmail} is not staff (its role is user)` };
    const [personal] = await tx.select({ id: users.id, role: users.role, deletedAt: users.deletedAt }).from(users).where(eq(users.id, profile.id)).limit(1).for("share");
    if (!personal || personal.deletedAt !== null) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not a live account` };
    if (personal.id === staff.id) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is the staff account itself, which is always a party where it is one` };
    if (personal.role !== "user") return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is a staff account (its role is ${personal.role}); only a personal account is linked` };
    const added = await tx.insert(staffPersonalAccounts).values({ staffUserId: staff.id, personalUserId: personal.id }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
    if (added.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is already linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_added", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`link: @${handle} is linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- limits

/** The five limits on staff, in the order the command takes them. */
export interface StaffLimits {
  decisionsPerHour: number;
  decisionsPerDay: number;
  caseOpensPerDay: number;
  findingsPerDay: number;
  revealsPerDay: number;
}

const describeLimits = (l: StaffLimits) => `${l.decisionsPerHour} decisions an hour, ${l.decisionsPerDay} decisions a day, ${l.caseOpensPerDay} case opens a day, ${l.findingsPerDay} findings a day, ${l.revealsPerDay} reveals a day`;

/**
 * Sets the limits' one row, as the migrator: an upsert, so it also works on a database whose row is missing, that
 * changes the row only when one of the five numbers differs. Its audit row carries the five numbers and is written only
 * when the row was inserted or changed.
 */
export async function setLimits(migrateDb: Runner, limits: StaffLimits): Promise<Changed> {
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const l = moderationLimits;
    const written = await tx
      .insert(l)
      .values({ id: 1, ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: l.id,
        set: { ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` },
        setWhere: sql`(${l.decisionsPerHour}, ${l.decisionsPerDay}, ${l.caseOpensPerDay}, ${l.findingsPerDay}, ${l.revealsPerDay}) is distinct from
                      (${limits.decisionsPerHour}::int, ${limits.decisionsPerDay}::int, ${limits.caseOpensPerDay}::int, ${limits.findingsPerDay}::int, ${limits.revealsPerDay}::int)`,
      })
      .returning({ id: l.id });
    if (written.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `the limits already are ${describeLimits(limits)}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "moderation_limits_set", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { ...limits } });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`limits: set to ${describeLimits(limits)}. Keep these numbers in your own records: a restore brings back the ones of its backup.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- account-facts

/**
 * Prints an account's handle, address and creation time for the runbook's Art. 18 step, as the migrator, and records
 * that it did. Only for the subject of the named case: the account the case is about, or the author of its post.
 */
export async function accountFacts(migrateDb: Runner, handleGiven: string, caseId: string): Promise<Changed> {
  const handle = handleArg(handleGiven);
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const [profile] = await tx.select({ id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    const [subject] = await rowsOf<{ subject: string | null }>(
      tx,
      sql`select case when c.target_type = 'account' then c.target_id else (select p.author_id from posts p where p.id = c.target_id) end as subject from cases c where c.id = ${caseId}::uuid`,
    );
    if (!subject) return { ok: false, problem: `no case has the id ${caseId}` };
    if (subject.subject !== profile.id) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not the subject of case ${caseId}; nothing was read` };
    const [account] = await tx.select({ email: users.email, createdAt: users.createdAt }).from(users).where(eq(users.id, profile.id)).limit(1);
    if (!account) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} has no account row` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "account_facts_read", targetType: "user", targetId: profile.id, requestId: null, metadata: { caseId } });
    return {
      ok: true,
      lines: [
        `handle: @${profile.handle}`,
        `email: ${account.email}`,
        `account created: ${account.createdAt.toISOString()}`,
        "Keep this off the server, with your R2 or Art. 18 record of the case, and destroy it after an answer without a seal (README, runbook).",
      ],
    };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- access-request

/**
 * Drafts the moderation part of an answer to a GDPR access request and records that it did, on the API role: for a
 * handle the account's cases and its own reports, for an address the notices of the contacts the auth module found for
 * it (`contactsOf`, which alone can read a contact). The audit row carries counts only, and names the account for a
 * handle and nobody for an address.
 */
export async function accessRequest(
  apiDb: Runner,
  appOrigin: string,
  who: { handle: string } | { email: string },
  contactsOf: (email: string) => Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]>,
): Promise<{ ok: true; draft: AccountAccessDraft | ContactsAccessDraft } | { ok: false; problem: string }> {
  if ("handle" in who) {
    const handle = handleArg(who.handle);
    const [profile] = await apiDb.select({ id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    const draft = await accessDraftForAccount(apiDb, appOrigin, profile);
    await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: "user", targetId: profile.id, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: draft.cases.length, contacts: 0 } }));
    return { ok: true, draft };
  }
  const contacts = await contactsOf(who.email);
  const draft = await accessDraftForContacts(apiDb, appOrigin, contacts);
  await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: 0, contacts: contacts.length } }));
  return { ok: true, draft };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- text-verify

/** One thing text-verify found wrong, and what it is about: an audit row by its place, or a decision, a post, an image or a seal by its id. */
export interface TextProblem {
  about: "audit" | "decision" | "post" | "image" | "seal";
  id: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface TextReport {
  ok: boolean;
  /** The confirmed rows read, and the decisions, posts, images and seals in force checked. */
  auditRows: number;
  decisions: number;
  posts: number;
  images: number;
  seals: number;
  /** The first problems, in the order found. */
  problems: TextProblem[];
  problemCount: number;
}

/** How many rows text-verify reads at a time. */
export const TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
const PAGE = TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE;

/** The actions whose params name saved texts and snapshots by their digests. */
const CONFIRMED_ACTIONS = ["case_decided", "appeals_reviewed", "identity_revealed"];
/** The params members that name a saved text. */
const TEXT_MEMBERS = ["factsDigest", "reasonDigest", "legalReferenceDigest"];

interface NamingRow {
  place: number;
  action: string;
  actorId: string;
  targetType: string | null;
  targetId: string | null;
  params: Record<string, unknown>;
}

const isObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
const actionKey = (action: { kind: unknown; mediaId: unknown }) => `${String(action.kind)}:${action.mediaId === null || action.mediaId === undefined ? "" : String(action.mediaId)}`;

/**
 * text-verify (3c design, section 7.13), read-only on the API's role. audit-verify proves that the record was not
 * rewritten; this proves that what the record's confirmed rows name is still what korbat holds, and that what posts and
 * images show is what the record says. Three checks, each in this command's own code:
 *
 *   1. Every digest in the params of a confirmed row (a decision, a review, a reveal) names a saved text that korbat
 *      still holds and that recomputes to it, an erased text, a snapshot still held that recomputes to it, or an erased
 *      snapshot. A text or a snapshot that is missing was removed around the erasures, which keep each row and its digest.
 *   2. Every decision is named by exactly one such row, written by the deciding account on the decision's case (for a
 *      review, on the reviewed decision), whose params equal the decision's own columns and whose actions equal its
 *      ledger rows as a set. A row that names a decision korbat does not hold is reported too.
 *   3. Every post's level and every image's state equal what the ledger of measures gives, worked out here from the
 *      ledger's rows, the cases' closures, the items and the erasure marks, as the database's own writer derives them;
 *      and every post a seal in force lists still has the number of image rows the seal recorded.
 *
 * So a change made around the triggers, by the migrator or by hand, is reported: a decision or a measure altered or
 * removed, a level or a state set, a sealed image row destroyed or lost in a restore. `keep` bounds the problems kept.
 */
export async function textVerify(q: Runner, keep = 100): Promise<TextReport> {
  const problems: TextProblem[] = [];
  let problemCount = 0;
  const problem = (about: TextProblem["about"], id: string, message: string) => {
    problemCount++;
    if (problems.length < keep) problems.push({ about, id, message });
  };

  // ---- 1. the confirmed rows and what their digests name
  const naming = new Map<string, NamingRow[]>();
  let auditRows = 0;
  for (let after = 0; ; ) {
    const page = await rowsOf<{ id: number; place: number; action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: unknown }>(
      q,
      sql`select id::int as id, chain_seq::int as place, action, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata from audit_log
           where action = any(${textArray(CONFIRMED_ACTIONS)}) and id > ${after} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    const wanted: { place: number; member: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    const wantedSnapshots: { place: number; id: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    for (const row of page) {
      auditRows++;
      const metadata = isObject(row.metadata) ? row.metadata : {};
      const params = isObject(metadata.params) ? metadata.params : null;
      if (params === null) {
        problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, carries no params`);
        continue;
      }
      for (const member of TEXT_MEMBERS) if (typeof params[member] === "string") wanted.push({ place: row.place, member, digest: params[member] });
      if (typeof params.snapshotId === "string" && typeof params.snapshotDigest === "string") wantedSnapshots.push({ place: row.place, id: params.snapshotId, digest: params.snapshotDigest });
      if (row.action !== "identity_revealed") {
        const decisionId = typeof metadata.decisionId === "string" ? metadata.decisionId : null;
        if (decisionId === null) problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, names no decision`);
        else naming.set(decisionId, [...(naming.get(decisionId) ?? []), { place: row.place, action: row.action, actorId: row.actor_id, targetType: row.target_type, targetId: row.target_id, params }]);
      }
    }
    if (wanted.length > 0) {
      const texts = await rowsOf<{ digest: string; text: string | null; salt: string | null }>(q, sql`select digest, text, salt from staff_texts where digest = any(${textArray([...new Set(wanted.map((w) => w.digest))])})`);
      const byDigest = new Map(texts.map((t) => [t.digest, t]));
      for (const w of wanted) {
        const held = byDigest.get(w.digest);
        if (!held) problem("audit", String(w.place), `its ${w.member} names no saved text`);
        // An erased text keeps its row and its digest: that is retention at work, and nothing to report.
        else if (held.text !== null && (held.salt === null || (await textDigest(held.salt, held.text).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest)) problem("audit", String(w.place), `the text its ${w.member} names no longer recomputes to that digest`);
      }
    }
    if (wantedSnapshots.length > 0) {
      const found = await rowsOf<Record<string, unknown> & { id: string; digest: string; erased: boolean }>(
        q,
        sql`select id, digest, erased_at is not null as erased, salt, target_type::text as target_type, target_id,
                   to_char(taken_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as taken_at, author_handle, post_state::text as post_state,
                   to_char(post_created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as post_created_at, reply_to_id, quote_of_id, body, media, display_name, bio, handle
              from evidence_snapshots where id = any(${uuidArray([...new Set(wantedSnapshots.map((w) => w.id))])})`,
      );
      const byId = new Map(found.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      for (const w of wantedSnapshots) {
        const s = byId.get(w.id);
        if (!s) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotId names no snapshot");
        else if (s.digest !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotDigest is not the digest of the snapshot it names");
        else if (!s.erased) {
          const input = { salt: s.salt, targetType: s.target_type, targetId: s.target_id, takenAt: s.taken_at, authorHandle: s.author_handle, postState: s.post_state, postCreatedAt: s.post_created_at, replyToId: s.reply_to_id, quoteOfId: s.quote_of_id, body: s.body, media: s.media, displayName: s.display_name, bio: s.bio, handle: s.handle } as unknown as SnapshotDigestInput;
          if ((await snapshotDigest(input).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest");
        }
      }
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  // ---- 2. every decision against the one row that names it
  let decisions = 0;
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; d: Record<string, unknown>; actions: { kind: string; mediaId: string | null }[] }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select d.id, to_jsonb(d) as d,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', a.kind, 'mediaId', a.media_id)) from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::jsonb) as actions
            from decisions d where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`d.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by d.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const { id, d, actions } of page) {
      decisions++;
      seen.add(id);
      const named = naming.get(id) ?? [];
      if (named.length !== 1) {
        problem("decision", id, named.length === 0 ? "no confirmed row of the audit log names it" : `${named.length} rows of the audit log name it (places ${named.map((row) => row.place).join(", ")})`);
        continue;
      }
      const row = named[0]!;
      const review = d.kind === "review";
      const expected: Record<string, unknown> = review
        ? { stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, appealId: d.appeal_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest }
        : {
            kind: d.kind, stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, throughSeq: d.through_seq, reviewsDecisionId: d.reviews_decision_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome,
            ground: d.ground, ruleId: d.rule_id, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, categoryKeyword: d.category_keyword,
            factsDigest: d.facts_digest, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest, legalReferenceDigest: d.legal_reference_digest,
          };
      const differing: string[] = [];
      if (row.actorId !== d.decided_by) differing.push("actor");
      if (row.action !== (review ? "appeals_reviewed" : "case_decided") || row.targetType !== (review ? "decision" : "case") || row.targetId !== (review ? d.reviews_decision_id : d.case_id)) differing.push("target");
      for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(expected), ...Object.keys(row.params)])) {
        if (key !== "actions" && (expected[key] ?? null) !== (row.params[key] ?? null)) differing.push(key);
        if (key !== "actions" && !(key in expected)) differing.push(key);
      }
      const recorded = Array.isArray(row.params.actions) ? row.params.actions.filter(isObject).map((a) => actionKey({ kind: a.kind, mediaId: a.mediaId })) : null;
      if (recorded === null || [...recorded].sort().join("|") !== actions.map(actionKey).sort().join("|")) differing.push("actions");
      if (differing.length > 0) problem("decision", id, `it differs from the audit row at place ${row.place} that names it: ${[...new Set(differing)].sort().join(", ")}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const [decisionId, named] of naming) if (!seen.has(decisionId)) problem("decision", decisionId, `the audit row at place ${named[0]!.place} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`);

  // ---- 3. levels and states, worked out from the ledger
  const measures = MEASURE_KINDS as readonly string[];
  const removedPosts = new Set<string>();
  const withheldPosts = new Set<string>();
  const removedImages = new Set<string>();
  const withheldImages = new Set<string>();
  const sealsInForce = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; kind: string; post_id: string | null; media_id: string | null; decision_kind: string; case_open: boolean; suspect_open: boolean; reversed: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select a.id, a.kind::text as kind, a.post_id, a.media_id, d.kind::text as decision_kind, c.closed_at is null as case_open,
                 exists (select 1 from intake_items i where i.case_id = d.case_id and i.suspect and i.answered_by is null and i.created_at <= d.decided_at) as suspect_open,
                 exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) as reversed
            from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
           where a.kind::text = any(${textArray(measures)}) and ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`a.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by a.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const m of page) {
      // In force: no row reverses it, and a measure taken while deciding lasts while its case is open, a seal taken while
      // deciding while its case holds an unanswered suspect item that arrived no later than it.
      const inForce = !m.reversed && (m.decision_kind !== "interim" || (m.kind === "seal_media" ? m.suspect_open : m.case_open));
      if (!inForce) continue;
      if (m.kind === "remove" && m.post_id) removedPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold" && m.post_id) withheldPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "remove_media" && m.media_id) removedImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold_media" && m.media_id) withheldImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "seal_media") sealsInForce.add(m.id);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  // The posts each seal in force lists, with the image rows it recorded for each.
  const listed: { actionId: string; postId: string; images: number }[] = [];
  const sealedPosts = new Set<string>();
  if (sealsInForce.size > 0) {
    const found = await rowsOf<{ action_id: string; post_id: string; images: number }>(q, sql`select action_id, post_id, images::int as images from seal_posts where action_id = any(${uuidArray([...sealsInForce])}) order by action_id, post_id`);
    for (const row of found) {
      listed.push({ actionId: row.action_id, postId: row.post_id, images: row.images });
      sealedPosts.add(row.post_id);
    }
  }

  let posts = 0;
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; state: string; level: string; erased: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select id, state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level, erased_at is not null as erased from posts where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`id > ${after}::uuid`} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const post of page) {
      posts++;
      const level = post.erased || removedPosts.has(post.id) ? "removed" : withheldPosts.has(post.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (post.level !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its level is stored as ${post.level}, and the ledger of measures gives ${level}`);
      // The state mirrors the level unless the author deleted the post, which is terminal.
      else if (post.state !== "deleted_by_author" && post.state !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its state is stored as ${post.state}, and its level is ${level}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  let images = 0;
  const imagesOn = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page = await imageModerationStates(q as Db, after, PAGE);
    for (const image of page) {
      images++;
      if (sealedPosts.has(image.postId)) imagesOn.set(image.postId, (imagesOn.get(image.postId) ?? 0) + 1);
      const state = sealedPosts.has(image.postId) ? "sealed" : image.erasedAt !== null || removedImages.has(image.id) ? "removed" : withheldImages.has(image.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (image.moderationState !== state) problem("image", image.id, `its state is stored as ${image.moderationState}, and the ledger of measures gives ${state}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const row of listed) {
    const now = imagesOn.get(row.postId) ?? 0;
    if (now !== row.images) problem("seal", row.actionId, `it lists post ${row.postId} with ${row.images} image ${row.images === 1 ? "row" : "rows"}, and the post has ${now} now`);
  }

  return { ok: problemCount === 0, auditRows, decisions, posts, images, seals: sealsInForce.size, problems, problemCount };
}

/** text-verify on the command line's own connection: one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction, so every check reads one state of the database. */
export function textVerifyOn(apiDb: Db): Promise<TextReport> {
  return apiDb.transaction(
    async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      return textVerify(tx);
    },
    { isolationLevel: "repeatable read", accessMode: "read only" },
  );
}

/** How text-verify reports: what holds, or the first problems. */
export function describeTextReport(report: TextReport): string[] {
  const counted = `${report.auditRows} confirmed rows, ${report.decisions} decisions, ${report.posts} posts, ${report.images} images and ${report.seals} seals in force`;
  if (report.ok) return [`text-verify: what the record names is what korbat holds: ${counted}`];
  const shown = report.problems.slice(0, 20);
  const lines = [`text-verify: FAILED, ${report.problemCount} ${report.problemCount === 1 ? "problem" : "problems"} in ${counted}; the first:`];
  for (const p of shown) lines.push(`  ${p.about === "audit" ? "place" : p.about} ${p.id}: ${p.message}`);
  if (report.problemCount > shown.length) lines.push(`  and ${report.problemCount - shown.length} more`);
  return lines;
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/access.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { imageModerationStates } from "../media";
import { accountLink, postLink } from "./links";
import { iso, rows, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The moderation part of an answer to a GDPR access request, drafted for the operator by `staff.js access-request` (3c
 * design, section 7.13). It is a draft: a person weighs it before anything is sent. It prints what korbat holds about
 * the requester's own content and conduct, and it never prints who reported them: every reporter's and notifier's
 * identity is withheld, by name of the rule, and each text another person wrote (a report's explanation and cited law,
 * a re-examination's statement) is printed apart, marked for the weighing the law asks for.
 *
 * The reads are this module's own tables on the API role. An image is named by its id and its stored state, read
 * through the media module, never opened; a sealed one is named and nothing more.
 */

export const ACCESS_WORDS = {
  /** Why no reporter's or notifier's identity is in the draft. */
  identities: "rights of others: GDPR Art. 15(4), recital 63",
  /** What stands beside every text another person wrote. */
  weigh: "send only after a person has weighed the writer's rights (C-203/22)",
  /** What stands on every case that holds an item of the urgent lane, open or closed. */
  authorities:
    "check the R2, Art. 18 and order records before sending: an authority may need the person not to be told yet, or national law may restrict access (GDPR Art. 23(1)(d))",
  /** The source of an item, as a category: never a count, a name or a report's words. */
  sources: { report: "a report by another user", notice: "a notice under Article 16", finding: "found by a moderator" },
} as const;

/** A part of the draft, printed as JSON for the operator: nothing reads it back. */
type Json = unknown;

/** Ids as one uuid[] parameter. */
const uuids = (ids: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;

const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

/**
 * The greatest uuid below this one, or null for the lowest: PostgreSQL orders uuids as 128-bit numbers, so a page of one
 * row after it starts at the id itself when a row has it. That reads one image row by its id through the one function
 * this module may read image rows with.
 */
export function uuidBefore(id: string): string | null {
  if (!UUID.test(id)) throw new TypeError("not a lower-case uuid");
  const value = BigInt(`0x${id.replaceAll("-", "")}`);
  if (value === 0n) return null;
  const hex = (value - 1n).toString(16).padStart(32, "0");
  return `${hex.slice(0, 8)}-${hex.slice(8, 12)}-${hex.slice(12, 16)}-${hex.slice(16, 20)}-${hex.slice(20)}`;
}

/** The stored state of each of these images, "gone" for one whose row no longer exists. */
async function imageStates(q: Runner, ids: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const states = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const id of new Set(ids)) {
    if (!UUID.test(id)) continue;
    const [row] = await imageModerationStates(q as Db, uuidBefore(id), 1);
    states.set(id, row?.id === id ? row.moderationState : "gone");
  }
  return states;
}

/** What an intake alleged, in one word. */
const groundOf = (row: { csam: boolean; alleges_illegal: boolean }) => (row.csam ? "child sexual abuse material" : row.alleges_illegal ? "illegal content" : "a korbat rule");

/** The notices and reports these intakes are, each with its items as their sender is shown them: for the requester's own reports, and for a notifier's. */
async function noticesWhere(q: Runner, appOrigin: string, where: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<Json[]> {
  const intakes = await rows<{ id: string; ref: string; received_at: string; csam: boolean; alleges_illegal: boolean; rule_id: string | null; category: string; explanation: string | null; cited_law: string | null; erased: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select n.id, n.ref, ${iso("n.received_at")} as received_at, n.csam, n.alleges_illegal, n.rule_id, n.category, n.explanation, n.cited_law, n.erased_at is not null as erased
          from intakes n where ${where} order by n.received_at, n.id`,
  );
  if (intakes.length === 0) return [];
  const items = await rows<{ intake_id: string; position: number; target_type: "post" | "account"; target_id: string; named_handle: string | null; shown: string | null; reexamination: boolean; statement: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select i.intake_id, i.position, i.target_type, i.target_id, i.named_handle, i.shown_outcome::text as shown, i.reexamines_item_id is not null as reexamination, i.statement
          from intake_items i where i.intake_id = any(${uuids(intakes.map((row) => row.id))}) order by i.intake_id, i.position, i.created_at, i.id`,
  );
  return intakes.map((n) => ({
    ref: n.ref,
    receivedAt: n.received_at,
    ground: groundOf(n),
    rule: n.rule_id,
    category: n.category,
    // The sender's own words, while korbat still holds them.
    explanation: n.explanation,
    citedLaw: n.cited_law,
    recordErased: n.erased,
    items: items
      .filter((item) => item.intake_id === n.id)
      .map((item) => ({
        item: item.position,
        // The address as the report named it: an account's under the handle it was named by, never a later one.
        link: item.target_type === "post" ? postLink(appOrigin, item.target_id) : accountLink(appOrigin, item.named_handle ?? ""),
        // Only what was released to the sender; an outcome that waits for the daily release is not shown here either.
        shownOutcome: item.shown,
        reexamination: item.reexamination,
        statement: item.statement,
      })),
  }));
}

export interface AccountAccessDraft {
  subject: { handle: string };
  cases: Json[];
  ownReports: Json[];
  withheld: { identities: { count: number; reason: string }; texts: Json[] };
}

/**
 * The draft for an account: every case about the account or one of its posts, whatever its outcome, with each item's
 * source category, ground, rule and category; its snapshots with their content unless it is withheld; every decision
 * with its statement's data and its texts while they are held; and the account's own appeals with their statements.
 * Then the account's own reports and notices. A case that holds an item of the urgent lane, open or closed, is marked
 * for the check of the authorities' records.
 */
export async function accessDraftForAccount(q: Runner, appOrigin: string, account: { id: string; handle: string }): Promise<AccountAccessDraft> {
  const cases = await rows<{ id: string; target_type: "post" | "account"; target_id: string; opened_at: string; closed_at: string | null; urgent: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select c.id, c.target_type, c.target_id, ${iso("c.opened_at")} as opened_at, ${iso("c.closed_at")} as closed_at,
               exists (select 1 from intake_items i where i.case_id = c.id and i.lane = 0) as urgent
          from cases c
         where (c.target_type = 'account' and c.target_id = ${account.id}::uuid)
            or (c.target_type = 'post' and c.target_id in (select p.id from posts p where p.author_id = ${account.id}::uuid))
         order by c.opened_at, c.id`,
  );
  const ids = uuids(cases.map((row) => row.id));
  const items = await rows<{ case_id: string; kind: string; csam: boolean; alleges_illegal: boolean; rule_id: string | null; category: string; arrived_at: string; identified: boolean; explanation: string | null; cited_law: string | null; statement: string | null; intake_id: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select i.case_id, n.kind::text as kind, n.csam, n.alleges_illegal, n.rule_id, n.category, ${iso("i.created_at")} as arrived_at,
               (i.reporter_account_id is not null or n.contact_id is not null) as identified, n.explanation, n.cited_law, i.statement, n.id as intake_id
          from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where i.case_id = any(${ids}) order by i.case_id, i.seq`,
  );
  const snapshots = await rows<{ id: string; case_id: string; taken_at: string; erased_on: string | null; withheld: boolean; author_handle: string; post_state: string | null; body: string | null; media: { id: string; alt: string | null; width: number; height: number }[] | null; display_name: string | null; bio: string | null; handle: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select s.id, s.case_id, ${iso("s.taken_at")} as taken_at, to_char(s.erased_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as erased_on, public.snapshot_withheld(s.id) as withheld,
               s.author_handle, s.post_state::text as post_state, s.body, s.media, s.display_name, s.bio, s.handle
          from evidence_snapshots s where s.case_id = any(${ids}) order by s.case_id, s.taken_at, s.id`,
  );
  const decisions = await rows<{ id: string; case_id: string; kind: string; outcome: string; ground: string | null; rule_id: string | null; rules_version: number; category: string; source: string; decided_at: string; redacted_on: string | null; facts: string | null; reason: string | null; legal_reference: string | null; has_facts: boolean; has_reason: boolean; has_legal: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.case_id, d.kind::text as kind, d.outcome::text as outcome, d.ground::text as ground, d.rule_id, d.rules_version, d.category, d.source::text as source,
               ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, to_char(d.redacted_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as redacted_on,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.facts_digest) as facts,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.reason_digest) as reason,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.legal_reference_digest) as legal_reference,
               d.facts_digest is not null as has_facts, d.reason_digest is not null as has_reason, d.legal_reference_digest is not null as has_legal
          from decisions d where d.case_id = any(${ids}) order by d.case_id, d.decided_at, d.id`,
  );
  const actions = await rows<{ decision_id: string; kind: string; media_id: string | null; no_effect: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.decision_id, a.kind::text as kind, a.media_id, a.no_effect from decision_actions a
         where a.decision_id = any(${uuids(decisions.map((row) => row.id))}) order by a.decision_id, a.kind::text, a.media_id`,
  );
  const appeals = await rows<{ decision_id: string; case_id: string; filed_at: string; statement: string | null; erased: boolean; result: string | null; answered_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.decision_id, d.case_id, ${iso("a.filed_at")} as filed_at, a.statement, a.erased_at is not null as erased, a.result::text as result, ${iso("a.answered_at")} as answered_at
          from appeals a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
         where d.case_id = any(${ids}) and a.appellant_account_id = ${account.id}::uuid order by a.filed_at, a.id`,
  );
  // Each image a shown snapshot lists, by its stored state now.
  const states = await imageStates(q, snapshots.filter((s) => !s.withheld).flatMap((s) => (s.media ?? []).map((image) => image.id)));

  /** A statement text: the text while korbat holds it, and whether one was ever given. */
  const text = (given: boolean, held: string | null): Json => (given ? (held === null ? { erased: true } : held) : null);
  const withheldTexts: Json[] = [];
  const seenIntakes = new Set<string>();
  for (const item of items) {
    // A report's own words stand once for its intake, a re-examination's statement for its item.
    if (!seenIntakes.has(`${item.case_id}:${item.intake_id}`)) {
      seenIntakes.add(`${item.case_id}:${item.intake_id}`);
      if (item.explanation !== null) withheldTexts.push({ caseId: item.case_id, kind: "explanation", text: item.explanation, note: ACCESS_WORDS.weigh });
      if (item.cited_law !== null) withheldTexts.push({ caseId: item.case_id, kind: "cited_law", text: item.cited_law, note: ACCESS_WORDS.weigh });
    }
    if (item.statement !== null) withheldTexts.push({ caseId: item.case_id, kind: "reexamination_statement", text: item.statement, note: ACCESS_WORDS.weigh });
  }

  return {
    subject: { handle: account.handle },
    cases: cases.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      target: c.target_type === "post" ? { type: "post", link: postLink(appOrigin, c.target_id) } : { type: "account", link: accountLink(appOrigin, account.handle) },
      openedAt: c.opened_at,
      closedAt: c.closed_at,
      authoritiesCheck: c.urgent ? ACCESS_WORDS.authorities : null,
      items: items
        .filter((item) => item.case_id === c.id)
        .map((item) => ({
          source: item.kind === "finding" ? ACCESS_WORDS.sources.finding : item.alleges_illegal ? ACCESS_WORDS.sources.notice : ACCESS_WORDS.sources.report,
          ground: groundOf(item),
          rule: item.rule_id,
          category: item.category,
          arrivedAt: item.arrived_at,
        })),
      snapshots: snapshots
        .filter((s) => s.case_id === c.id)
        .map((s) =>
          s.withheld
            ? // An erased copy with the day it went and no content; a copy of content erased since is withheld the same way.
              { id: s.id, takenAt: s.taken_at, erasedOn: s.erased_on, withheld: true, content: null }
            : {
                id: s.id,
                takenAt: s.taken_at,
                erasedOn: null,
                withheld: false,
                content: {
                  authorHandle: s.author_handle,
                  postState: s.post_state,
                  body: s.body,
                  displayName: s.display_name,
                  bio: s.bio,
                  handle: s.handle,
                  // A sealed image is named by its id and its state and nothing more.
                  media: (s.media ?? []).map((image) => (states.get(image.id) === "sealed" ? { id: image.id, state: "sealed" } : { id: image.id, state: states.get(image.id) ?? "gone", alt: image.alt, width: image.width, height: image.height })),
                },
              },
        ),
      decisions: decisions
        .filter((d) => d.case_id === c.id)
        .map((d) => ({
          id: d.id,
          kind: d.kind,
          outcome: d.outcome,
          ground: d.ground,
          rule: d.rule_id,
          rulesVersion: d.rules_version,
          category: d.category,
          source: d.source,
          decidedAt: d.decided_at,
          contentErasedOn: d.redacted_on,
          measures: actions.filter((a) => a.decision_id === d.id).map((a) => ({ kind: a.kind, image: a.media_id, noEffect: a.no_effect })),
          facts: text(d.has_facts, d.facts),
          reason: text(d.has_reason, d.reason),
          legalReference: text(d.has_legal, d.legal_reference),
        })),
      appeals: appeals
        .filter((a) => a.case_id === c.id)
        .map((a) => ({ decisionId: a.decision_id, filedAt: a.filed_at, statement: a.erased ? { erased: true } : a.statement, result: a.result, answeredAt: a.answered_at })),
    })),
    ownReports: await noticesWhere(q, appOrigin, sql`n.reporter_id = ${account.id}::uuid`),
    withheld: { identities: { count: items.filter((item) => item.identified).length, reason: ACCESS_WORDS.identities }, texts: withheldTexts },
  };
}

export interface ContactsAccessDraft {
  contacts: { name: string | null; notices: Json[] }[];
}

/** The draft for a signed-out notifier, by the contacts the auth module found for their address: the name each gave and the notices filed under it. */
export async function accessDraftForContacts(q: Runner, appOrigin: string, contacts: readonly { id: string; name: string | null }[]): Promise<ContactsAccessDraft> {
  const drafted: ContactsAccessDraft["contacts"] = [];
  for (const contact of contacts) drafted.push({ name: contact.name, notices: await noticesWhere(q, appOrigin, sql`n.contact_id = ${contact.id}::uuid`) });
  return { contacts: drafted };
}
```
